M1 — 2026-09-17
Claude Code honours a PER-TOOL always-load flag set by the MCP server itself: a tool whose `_meta` carries `"anthropic/alwaysLoad": true` skips tool-search deferral, exactly like `alwaysLoad: true` on the server entry in .mcp.json. It needs no user config and no re-init. Verified 2026-09-17 in the installed binaries 2.1.270, 2.1.272, 2.1.273 (the bench pin) and 2.1.274: `alwaysLoad: h || K._meta?.["anthropic/alwaysLoad"] === !0`. To re-check a version, run `LC_ALL=C grep -a -c 'anthropic/alwaysLoad"\]===!0' ~/.local/share/claude/versions/<v>`; it prints 2 when supported. Stdio MCP servers get CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID in their env from 2.1.154, and on --resume from 2.1.163 (changelog). It equals the hooks' session_id.
